So assignment only? The criteria: assignment_only: "No; it establishes planned allocation, while physical exposure requires additional evidence because cross-range contamination is discussed." That fits. zero_exposure_established: Yes; assignment to unseeded range establishes no seeding material. But cross-range contamination evidence says not. So q2 = assignment_only.

Need ensure schema only q1 q2. JSON. Final.
